verdict.rationale: Trivy is a security scanner, so cross-file taint analysis is a fair axis for it. But the evidence only documents known-vulnerability detection in images and lock files, secret scanning, IaC misconfiguration checks, license scanning and SBOM generation. Nothing shows source-code dataflow or taint tracking across files or function boundaries.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can detect taint-style vulnerabilities that flow across files and function boundaries
